:new: New project intention · #43 Stickelberger's theorem and the Kronecker-Weber theorem

Formalising Stickelberger's theorem (the Stickelberger element annihilates the class group of ℚ(ζ)) and the Kronecker-Weber theorem (every abelian extension of ℚ lies in a cyclotomic field), the second deduced from the first following Lemmermeyer, "Kronecker-Weber via Stickelberger" (arXiv:1108.5671). Blueprint at https://xroblot.github.io/SKW/blueprint/.

Stickelberger is essentially complete. For Kronecker-Weber, the odd prime power case is done and the p = 2 case remains.
